label: Task-15
title: Build D3.js force-directed graph component
description:
Create the visual graph component using D3.js force simulation.

## Background
With Task-14 providing the data, this task renders the interactive graph visualization.

## Requirements
- Create `graph-viewer.js` web component
- Use D3.js force-directed layout
- Color nodes by type (bug=red, task=blue, feature=green, etc.)
- Show node labels and titles
- Draw directed edges with link type labels
- Pan and zoom support
- Click node to select/highlight

## Component API
```javascript
<graph-viewer 
    root-label="Feature-11"
    root-type="feature" 
    depth="2">
</graph-viewer>
```

## Events to Emit
- `node-selected` - when user clicks a node
- `node-double-click` - navigate to node detail

## Color Scheme
```javascript
const colors = {
    bug: '#ef4444',
    task: '#3b82f6',
    feature: '#22c55e',
    version: '#f59e0b',
    'user-story': '#06b6d4',
    person: '#8b5cf6'
};
```

## Files to Create
- `components/graph-viewer/graph-viewer.js`
- `components/graph-viewer/graph-viewer.css`
